The Chinese characters for Stephen

As a transliteration, Stephen is usually written 斯蒂芬 (Sī dì fēn). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

斯
Sī
this (transliteration)
蒂
dì
stem (of fruit)
芬
fēn
fragrance

Origin and meaning

Stephen comes from Greek and means “crown”.

About the name Stephen

Saint Stephen was the first Christian martyr.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Stephen carries the meaning “crown” and looks striking in brush strokes.
